programme.desc: Prem's grandfather calls off his wedding when an astrologer predicts that Prem will die if he marries Pooja. A year later, when Pooja is accused of killing her husband's uncle, Prem takes up her case.

programme.title: Namak Haram
programme.desc: Two young men from vastly different worlds, a Delhi slum and a Calcutta mansion, form a bond that is put to the ultimate test.

programme.title: Saajan Chale Sasural
programme.desc: A village-based singer attempts to find love and fame in the big city.

programme.title: Yaarana
programme.desc: Kishan and Bishan Kumar were childhood best friends. Young Bishan lives a wealthy life with his mom and Kishan was a former servant cum cook who later turns out to be a successful singer.

programme.title: Naseeb
programme.desc: When Pooja's father disapproves of her relation with Krishna, a humble man, he vows to become wealthy and returns to find that she is already married.

programme.title: Ramkali
programme.desc: Sultan, an inspector, becomes a fugitive and a bandit to avenge his father's death. He helps Ramkali, a dancer, and learns that her alias, bandit Raksha, is also seeking revenge against Shankar Singh.

programme.title: Naughty @ 40
programme.desc: Happy, a 40-year-old, marries Gauri, a childlike woman, and frustration leads him into the arms of a model. When Gauri finds out about their relation, she decides to change her attitude.

programme.title: Balika Badhu
programme.desc: Arduous journey of child bride Rajni who is married before she is old enough to understand what marriage is all about, against the backdrop of Indian freedom struggle.

programme.title: Conversation With Javed Akhtar 2
programme.desc: Lyricist, poet, screenwriter, Javed Akhtar along with film expert Nasreen Ali and Shabana Azmi, provides a fascinating and personal insight into his extraordinary life and new book Talking Life.

programme.title: Phir Milenge
programme.desc: A woman is fired from an ad agency when her employers get to know that she is HIV positive. Upset by her unfair dismissal, she seeks a lawyer to fight her case and restore her dignity.

programme.title: Patthar Ke Phool
programme.desc: A young police officer and the daughter of a gangster fall in love at first sight.

programme.title: Amne Samne
programme.desc: Gopi, a simpleton, plays along when Jyoti mistakes him for Johnny and offers him work. He, however, soon finds himself on the run from the police and the mafia due to his lookalike's criminal deeds.

programme.title: Khamoshi
programme.desc: Radha is a nurse at a hospital treating patients. Her work involves providing patients with unconditional love and care and in doing so she finds herself falling in love with them.

programme.title: Dedh Ishqiya
programme.desc: Comedy thriller. Out from jail, Khalujaan and Babban steal a necklace made with royal jewels.

programme.title: Dhool Ka Phool
programme.desc: Mahesh and Meena fall in love but he marries another girl at his father's behest. When Meena takes their baby to Mahesh, he rejects her saying their relationship was a mistake.

programme.title: Dastaan
programme.desc: When Vishnu, a reputed judge, is mistakenly assumed as Anil, who is the murderer of Dhanraj, he decides to travel to Anil's home town and unravel the mystery behind it.

programme.title: Gopala
programme.desc: A woman imprisoned for murder is spared of her death sentence since she is pregnant. She then plans to bring up her son to avenge the death of her husband. However, life has other plans in store.

programme.title: Amar Shakti
programme.desc: This film follows two brothers, heirs to the throne, who were separated because of the murder of their parents. One grows up and vows to avenge their death, while the other is oblivious.

programme.title: Naya Daur
programme.desc: A man brings turmoil to a peaceful village by disturbing the livelihood of the local farmers and workers. He does this by introducing new machinery in an attempt to make quicker profits.

programme.title: Gautam Govinda
programme.desc: A police officer is assigned to a village over-run by criminals. He bumps into his long lost brother who is the personal hit-man of the arrogant and aristocratic goon. Will faith bring them together.

programme.title: Safar
programme.desc: A pair of lovers are cruelly separated by destiny when the boy is diagnosed with terminal cancer. On his insistence, the girl settles down with another man, but he turns out to be a jealous husband.

programme.title: Geetanjali
programme.desc: A man learns that he is terminally ill and decides to live alone on a hill station. He meets a bubbly girl who teaches him how to live life to the fullest. Then, he makes another shocking discovery.

programme.title: Majhdhaar
programme.desc: Krishna loves Radha but they cannot marry against their parent's wishes. Although she is pregnant with Krishna's child, circumstances lead Radha to marry Gopal.

programme.title: Pratigyabadh

programme.title: Wolves and Lions: Old Enemies
programme.desc: A look at how canids and felines deploy an arsenal of hunting skills. Felines rely on endurance, and wolves on their privileged sense of smell in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Land of the Far North
programme.desc: Life in the Arctic Circle, where the sun hardly sets in summer. Food is abundant, but animals and plants alike face great challenges such as sleep deprivation, pests and predators.

programme.title: Land of the Far North
programme.desc: Cold and darkness dominate the Arctic Circle during winter, but nature copes astonishingly well. This documentary reveals how plants and animals survive these brutal conditions.

programme.title: Deadly Australians
programme.desc: From the oceans and the forest to swamps and deserts, a look at the toxic, venomous and dangerous creatures that Australia is home to.

programme.title: Wolves and Lions: Old Enemies
programme.desc: A look at how canids and felines deploy an arsenal of hunting skills. Felines rely on endurance, and wolves on their privileged sense of smell in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: The Alhambra fortress in Andalusia, Spain, a refuge for wildlife which provides the backdrop for the daily dramas and struggles of the region's amphibians, fish and birds.

programme.title: Osprey
programme.desc: When a veteran pair of osprey return home, they must take on enemies, elements and hundreds of fish if they wish to raise the next generation.

programme.title: Great Lakes Wild
programme.desc: The push to increase the population numbers of Ontario's eight turtle species, seven of which are listed as endangered. But turtles are slow and not entirely smart.

programme.title: Great Lakes Wild
programme.desc: A dam is an engineering feat that controls massive amounts of water. But as this episode shows, it can also wreak havoc on the animals that call those waters home.

programme.title: Mysteries of Evolution
programme.desc: The importance of cooperation in the animal kingdom, where some creatures work together to be social while others put the welfare of the group above their own potential.

programme.title: Mysteries of Evolution
programme.desc: From the shark to the horseshoe crab, meet the planet's 'living fossils' - the creatures that have survived relatively unchanged for millions of years.

programme.title: How the Wild Things Sleep
programme.desc: The secrets of the most extreme sleepers of the animal kingdom, looking at how they deal with sleep deprivation and trying to discover whether animals dream.

programme.title: Animals at Play
programme.desc: Part one of two. The reasons why young animals enjoy playing, and how it can teach them to survive in the wild. The programme explores how young elephants, which rarely leave their mothers' side for the first eight years of life, play to develop social skills, while macaques hone their mental agility by playing games with stones. Plus, a zoologist who looks after orphaned cheetahs reveals how play can help cubs learn to hunt.

programme.title: Animals at Play
programme.desc: Part two of two. The secrets behind animals' group games, from dolphins that play catch to a hyena tug of war, revealing the benefits they gain from their playful behaviour. The programme examines how breaching the rules of a game can have fatal consequences - but how it also presents an opportunity for animals with a rigid hierarchy to break down social barriers.

programme.title: World's Most Toxic Animals
programme.desc: First of two programmes about some of earth's most dangerous creatures, which lurk in the oceans, the forests, swamps and deserts. In Australia, meet the world's most venomous snake, and in nearby oceans, discover the deadly nature of the marine creatures that share these tropical waters.

programme.title: World's Most Toxic Animals
programme.desc: Exploring more of earth's dangerous creatures, beginning in the South American rainforest with the poison-packed golden dart frog, which harbours enough poison to kill 10 men. Plus, a visit to Sydney, Australia, home of the world's most venomous spider.

programme.title: Volcanic Odysseys
programme.desc: The story of Aztec warrior Popocatépetl - a giant active volcano - who erupts to wake his princess Iztaccíhuatl, a neighbouring ice-capped volcano.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas
programme.desc: Steer clear of these alphas, whose horns, claws, and other protective gear keep them ready for battle, no matter what the weather dishes out.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas
programme.desc: Come face-to-face with masters of stealth, from a sandhill crane as it leads in a deathly dance to a male brown hare as it throws swift punches at its beloved.

programme.title: Bears of the Karawank Mountains
programme.desc: Documentary following a young male brown bear on his adventures in a mountain range that forms a natural border between Slovenia and Austria.

programme.title: Animals Decoded
programme.desc: Communication in the animal world, beginning with the secrets of body language.

programme.title: Animals Decoded
programme.desc: The remarkable ways that animals speak to one another, from the trumpeting of enormous elephants to the chatter of seal colonies.

programme.title: Animals Decoded
programme.desc: Through sense, scent and sight, animals can communicate in ways that are outside of the reach of humans. Here, scientists dig further into their secrets.

programme.title: Superbeast
programme.desc: The shark, one of nature's oldest and deadliest predators, exploring how this ancient hunter adapts, endures and strikes with unstoppable precision.

programme.title: David Attenborough's First Life
programme.desc: In the first of a two-part documentary, the naturalist explores the origins of life on Earth. Beginning the journey near his childhood home in Charnwood Forest, Leicestershire, he learns how a fossil discovery transformed scientists' understanding of the evolution of complex organisms, and in Newfoundland and Australia he reveals the earliest kinds of animal to exist on the planet. With the help of cutting-edge technology and visual effects, the programme brings the creatures to life, demonstrating how they survived.

programme.title: David Attenborough's First Life
programme.desc: In the conclusion of the two-part documentary, the naturalist travels to Burgess Shale in Canada's Rocky Mountains, where he explores how evolution gained pace once creatures developed mouths and mobility. In Scotland, he reveals that one of the smallest fossils found holds the secret to how animals began surviving on dry land, and explains the bloom of life during the oxygen-rich Carboniferous period.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Tasmanian Devil
programme.desc: Part one of two. A look at the marsupial native only to the Australian island, revealing how the mating season is a chance for males to show who is dominant.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Tasmanian Devil
programme.desc: Tasmanian Devils might have infamous reputations, but these spirited scrappers are committed parents and heroic defenders of their pouch-reared young.

programme.title: Superbeast
programme.desc: The shark, one of nature's oldest and deadliest predators, exploring how this ancient hunter adapts, endures and strikes with unstoppable precision.

programme.title: Wild Philippines
programme.desc: Discovering a world shaped by fire and water, as cameras capture Philippine eagles soaring above ancient forests and rare crocodiles lurking below the river's surface.

programme.title: Wild Philippines
programme.desc: Cameras follow turtles and tiger sharks roaming volcanic reefs, and tarsiers leaping through forests on the hunt.

programme.title: Seasons of the Wild
programme.desc: A look at the unique ecosystem of Florida's Everglades, beginning with the season of drought, when conditions bring big changes. With water scarce, predators and prey are pushed dangerously close together.

programme.title: Seasons of the Wild
programme.sub-title: Everglades - The Season of the Flood
programme.desc: The rainy season in the Florida Everglades, a stark contrast to the dry winter which preceded it, as the 600-plus animal species expand both their hunting and breeding grounds.

programme.title: Invisible River: Under Water Between the Black Forest and the Vosges
programme.desc: A documentary about the largest groundwater reservoir in Europe, which forms an underground river in the Upper Rhine Valley. Underwater cameraman Serge Dumont capture footage of the inhabitants of this biotope.

programme.title: Ocean Parks
programme.desc: Profiles of the world's most spectacular marine habitats, beginning with the Caribbean island of Bonaire, a leading destination for eco-tourists.

programme.title: Ocean Parks
programme.desc: Efforts to protect three important Florida Keys habitats, including crucial coral reefs and the swampy homes of endangered birds.

programme.title: Ol Pejeta Diaries
programme.desc: The vets focus on the lives of the park's zebras. First on the agenda is the endangered Grevy's zebra, which must be isolated to encourage breeding.

programme.desc: A vet is leaving the park after eight years, and for their last job is organising the team for a daunting relocation of around 500 animals. It requires a massive effort.

programme.desc: The rescued children struggle to find a sense of normality and the cult leader is tracked down by detectives when she goes on the run.

programme.title: The Cult of the Family
programme.desc: An insider's testimony reveals enough evidence to arrest Anne Hamilton-Byrne and her husband Bill. But it remains to be seen whether justice will be served.

programme.title: Costa Concordia: Chronicle of a Disaster
programme.desc: Documentary told from different perspectives of the sinking of the cruise ship, examining why it ran aground and how the chaotic evacuation took place.

programme.title: The Great Horsemeat Scandal
programme.desc: A look at the major news story that broke in 2013, when it was found that meat unfit for human consumption had been smuggled into the human food chain and turned into cheap frozen meals for companies including Aldi, Tesco, Lidl and Burger King. With testimonies from whistleblowers, detectives and activists.

programme.title: The Salisbury Poisonings: A Spy Next Door
programme.desc: A look at the nerve agent attack on former Russian spy Sergei Skripal and his daughter Yulia in Salisbury, with contributions from intelligence and counterterrorism officials, journalists and victims. The film uncovers how authorities raced to identify the perpetrators, contain a deadly chemical weapon and respond to one of the most brazen acts of state-sponsored aggression on British soil.

programme.title: Discovering: Ed Harris

programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Marshal
programme.desc: A young man puts his life on the line to investigate a hospital run by a crime syndicate that performs various unethical procedures on helpless patients.

programme.title: Blue Oranges
programme.desc: When a wealthy alcoholic turns up dead, Detective Nilesh investigates the murder by interrogating various suspects that include her former lover, a spoilt brat and the commissioner's brother.

programme.title: Fifty Fifty
programme.desc: Abandoned by his parents, Kishan becomes an elusive robber and teams up with Mary. However, when she leaves him to pursue her grand plan, he decides to seek revenge from the man who ruined his life.

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: Rajveer, a rich man, falls in love with Madhuri. However, he soon realises that she detests affluent people and in order to win her heart, he, along with his family, pretends to be poor.

programme.title: Khel
programme.desc: Three fraudsters trick a rich elderly woman, Sulakshana, who is desperately looking for her long-lost grandchild, in order to acquire her estate and property.

programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Rustum
programme.desc: ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.

programme.title: Pardesi
programme.desc: Myna rescues Ajay, who is bitten by a snake, but he loses his memory. He begins a new life with Myna and her family and the two fall in love, much to her secret lover's outrage.

programme.title: Love Mocktail
programme.desc: After rescuing a woman, Adi reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki
programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.title: Pighalta Aasman
programme.desc: Delhi-based businesswoman Arti Singh travels to Kashmir to claim her land from Suraj Arora. Soon after Arti and Suraj fall in love with each other, she learns that her friend Anu too loves him.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Apartment
programme.desc: Preeti, an air hostess, is tired of her unfaithful boyfriend and decides to throw him out of the house. To share the rent, she finds a roommate who appears to be a simple girl but has her own agenda.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Love Mocktail 2
programme.desc: With the semblance of leading a normal life, Adi struggles with the loss of his wife, Nidhi. However, Sihi, a charming young woman, enters as a glimmer of hope when she commits to helping Adi.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Dev discovers that his wife, Reena, has been cheating on him with Ranjit. To teach them a lesson, he decides to blackmail the cheating duo as part of his revenge.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Naya Din Nayi Raat

programme.title: Khel Khilari Ka

programme.title: Papi Gudia

programme.title: Barah Aana

programme.title: National Lampoon's Vacation
programme.desc: A bumbling all-American family man takes his wife and kids on a disaster-filled cross-country drive to California to visit famous theme park Walley World - but their chances of arriving at their destination in one piece are looking slim. Comedy, starring Chevy Chase, Beverly D'Angelo, Randy Quaid, Imogene Coca, Anthony Michael Hall, Christie Brinkley and John Candy.

programme.title: Blades of Glory
programme.desc: A bad-boy figure skater and his effeminate arch-enemy are banned from the sport after their intense rivalry results in a brawl. However, the pair find a loophole in the regulations allowing them to enter the world championships as the first ever same-sex pair - if they can put aside their differences long enough to compete. Comedy, starring Will Ferrell, Jon Heder, Will Arnett and Amy Poehler.

programme.title: Roofman
programme.desc: Former US Army Reserve officer Jeffrey Manchester executes a plan to rob multiple branches of McDonald's. He is eventually captured by police and becomes the first person to escape from Brown Creek Correctional Institution in North Carolina. Jeffrey hides out at a toy shop for several months, and during forays outside the building, he sparks romance with store worker Leigh Wainscott. Comedy drama, starring Channing Tatum, Kirsten Dunst and Peter Dinklage.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop II
programme.desc: Wisecracking Detroit detective Axel Foley returns to Los Angeles to investigate the shooting of an old friend, and uncovers a connection with a spate of violent robberies carried out by a criminal who leaves a mysterious calling card. Comedy thriller sequel, starring Eddie Murphy, Judge Reinhold, John Ashton, Ronny Cox and Brigitte Nielsen.

programme.title: Grimsby
programme.desc: Two brothers are separated at birth, the younger growing up to be MI6's top agent while the older becomes a layabout football hooligan. When they are finally reunited, the dim-witted elder sibling ends up helping his brother foil an evil plan that threatens the entire world. Action comedy, starring Sacha Baron Cohen, Mark Strong and Rebel Wilson.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 2
programme.desc: A Cappella group the Barden Bellas enjoy an unprecedented run of success, until a disastrous performance sees them banned from national competitions and beset by scandal. They attempt to turn their fortunes around and redeem their reputation by competing in the World Championships of A Cappella in Copenhagen. Comedy sequel, starring Anna Kendrick and Rebel Wilson.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: A writer struggling to complete the script for a movie about psychopathic killers turns to his criminal friends for advice. He ends up getting more than he bargained for when the small-time crooks kidnap a dog that belongs to a gangster, putting all their lives in danger. Comedy thriller, starring Colin Farrell, Sam Rockwell, Christopher Walken and Woody Harrelson.

programme.title: Notting Hill
programme.desc: A recently divorced bookshop owner finds love with a glamorous Hollywood film star, but ends up the focus of unwanted media interest - which makes maintaining a relationship a tricky proposition. Romantic comedy written by Richard Curtis, starring Hugh Grant, Julia Roberts, Rhys Ifans, Emma Chambers, James Dreyfus and Gina McKee.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 3
programme.desc: Following their win at the world championship, the now-separated Bellas (an all-female a cappella singing group) reunite for one last singing competition at an overseas USO tour. However, they face a squad who uses both instruments and voices. Final part of the blockbusting comedy trilogy, starring Anna Kendrick, Rebel Wilson and Brittany Snow.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: Nurse Greg is now the proud father of twins, but has yet to earn the respect of his wife's stern father after 10 years of marriage. The couple invite both sides of their extended family to the kids' birthday party, where Greg makes a desperate effort to finally prove his worth to his father-in-law. Comedy sequel, with Ben Stiller, Robert De Niro, Owen Wilson and Dustin Hoffman.

programme.title: Liar Liar
programme.desc: A lawyer whose underhand ploys to win cases leave him little time to see his son discovers he is incapable of lying after the boy's birthday wish makes his dad tell only the truth. However, this causes a host of problems as the attorney tries to muddle his way through a high-profile divorce settlement. Comedy, with Jim Carrey, Maura Tierney, Justin Cooper, Jennifer Tilly and Cary Elwes.

programme.title: Superbad
programme.desc: Two teenage friends are on the brink of going to different colleges, so decide to mark the event by going to a party where they hope to lose their virginity. However, they have promised to supply the booze for the event, a task that proves much harder than expected because they are under age. Unfortunately, when a friend steps in to help, the situation gets even worse. Comedy, starring Jonah Hill, Michael Cera and Christopher Mintz-Plasse.

programme.title: American Pie 2
programme.desc: The teenagers reunite after their first year at college to spend the summer at a lake house. Jim is concerned by his lack of sexual experience, and goes in search of an old flame, Oz struggles to keep a long-term relationship going, and Finch tries to master the art of tantric sex. Comedy sequel, starring Jason Biggs, Chris Klein, Seann William Scott, Alyson Hannigan and Eugene Levy.

programme.title: Notting Hill
programme.desc: A recently divorced bookshop owner finds love with a glamorous Hollywood film star, but ends up the focus of unwanted media interest - which makes maintaining a relationship a tricky proposition. Romantic comedy written by Richard Curtis, starring Hugh Grant, Julia Roberts, Rhys Ifans, Emma Chambers, James Dreyfus and Gina McKee.

programme.title: The Longest Yard
programme.desc: A washed-up quarterback ends up in jail after a drunken night out, and is ordered by the warden to put together an American football team to take on the guards, with the help of a former college champ. Remake of 1974 comedy The Mean Machine, with Adam Sandler, Chris Rock, Nelly and Burt Reynolds, who starred in the original.

programme.title: The Natural
programme.desc: A baseball prodigy's dreams of sporting stardom are cut short when he gets shot. Once he has recovered from his injuries, he rejoins his team as a rookie recruit at an age when most players are thinking of retiring - only to enjoy an unexpected run of success. Drama, starring Robert Redford, Glenn Close, Kim Basinger, Robert Duvall and Barbara Hershey.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 3
programme.desc: Following their win at the world championship, the now-separated Bellas (an all-female a cappella singing group) reunite for one last singing competition at an overseas USO tour. However, they face a squad who uses both instruments and voices. Final part of the blockbusting comedy trilogy, starring Anna Kendrick, Rebel Wilson and Brittany Snow.

programme.title: Spider-Man 3
programme.desc: A sinister alien parasite brings out the web-slinging hero's darker side, filling him with thoughts of revenge on his uncle's murderer, the shape-shifting Sandman. Meanwhile, he also has to contend with the challenge of his best friend following in his father's villainous footsteps - and a jealous rival developing superpowers of his own. Superhero sequel, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst and James Franco.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programme.desc: A gifted teenager investigates the secrets hidden in his dead parents' past, leading him to a mysterious corporation and an incident that imbues him with superhuman powers. A personal tragedy drives him to use his new-found abilities to fight crime, and he is soon drawn into a deadly battle against a former colleague of his father, who has undergone a devastating transformation of his own. Superhero adventure reboot, starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone and Rhys Ifans.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: The webslinging hero battles a powerful new enemy when a downtrodden engineer develops lethal electrical powers, which he unleashes on those he believes have betrayed him. As if that wasn't enough to keep him busy, he faces an even greater threat when he is reunited with an unstable old friend who has been charged with a sinister mission by his dying father, leading to a series of tense confrontations that threaten to change his life for ever. Superhero adventure sequel, starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone, Jamie Foxx and Dane DeHaan.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Peter Parker balances life as an ordinary high school student with his superhero alter-ego Spider-Man, while waiting in vain to join his mentor Iron Man on a world-saving mission. Determined to prove he is ready for bigger challenges, he investigates a spree of crimes committed with advanced weapons - leading him into a battle with a ruthless winged enemy on the hunt for priceless technology. Superhero adventure, starring Tom Holland, Michael Keaton and Robert Downey Jr.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Heroes
programme.desc: From Wonder Woman and Indiana Jones to Trolls, expect daring adventures, epic battles and heroes and heroines saving the day.

programme.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
programme.desc: With the web-slinger's identity now revealed to the world, Peter Parker asks Doctor Strange for magical help to undo the damage. However, a spell gone wrong unleashes dangerous foes from parallel universes on the world. Comic-book adventure sequel, starring Tom Holland, Zendaya and Benedict Cumberbatch, with Willem Dafoe, Jamie Foxx and Alfred Molina among the stars of past Spider-Man movies reprising their roles.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
programme.desc: After being bitten by a radioactive arachnid, student Miles Morales develops incredible abilities, and becomes a version of Spider-Man. When a super collider device opens a gateway to other dimensions, Miles crosses paths with five counterparts to stop a threat for all realities. Oscar-winning animated adventure, with the voices of Shameik Moore and Nicolas Cage.

programme.title: Spider-Man
programme.desc: A clumsy teenager develops superhuman powers after a genetically engineered spider bites him. At first his fantastic skills delight him, but his elation is severely tempered by a family tragedy, prompting him to dedicate his talents to combating evil. However, he faces a baptism of fire in the form of crazed villain the Green Goblin. Comic-book superhero adventure, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, Willem Dafoe, James Franco and Rosemary Harris.

programme.title: Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Peter Parker continues his fight for justice, but unrequited love and personal worries take their toll and he is tempted to abandon his web-slinging alter ego. However, the arrival of deadly new bad guy Doctor Octopus plunges him into a race against time to save New York. Comic-book adventure sequel, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, Alfred Molina, James Franco and Rosemary Harris.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: Teenager Sam Witwicky is treated to his first car by his dad, but it turns out to be an alien scout with a life of its own. Before long, the vehicle embroils Sam in a long-running intergalactic war between two factions of giant shape-changing robots, which have come to Earth to find a mystical cube that grants infinite power to its possessor. Michael Bay's sci-fi action adventure, inspired by the toy franchise, with Shia LaBeouf, Megan Fox, Josh Duhamel, Jon Voight and John Turturro.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The war between the shape-shifting robots erupts once again, as the first of the evil Decepticons leads an attack on Earth to locate an ancient planet-destroying machine. Hapless teenager Sam Witwicky is caught in the middle of the ensuing conflict as he holds the key to discovering the location of the device. Sci-fi adventure sequel, starring Shia LaBeouf and Megan Fox.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: The heroic autobots discover that a spaceship from their own planet crashed into the moon decades ago, carrying their former leader and an incredibly powerful device. They must fight to defend the human race as their enemies the decepticons plot to use this machine to rebuild their own world and destroy the Earth. Sci-fi adventure sequel, with Shia LaBeouf, Josh Duhamel and Rosie Huntington-Whiteley.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: The shape-changing robots are driven into hiding when the human race turns against them. When rediscovered by a kindly inventor and his daughter, they come out of exile to save the world, battling a new breed of human-created Transformers. These deadly new machines were created to hunt them down, but are now growing independent and intend to make use of technology from the Transformers' home planet in a plot that could threaten all life on Earth. Fourth film in the sci-fi adventure series, starring Mark Wahlberg, Stanley Tucci and Kelsey Grammer.

programme.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
programme.desc: The shape-changing robots and their human allies face a confrontation with their original creator, who has brainwashed their leader and intends to save her own home planet by destroying Earth. To save the human race they must recover an ancient artefact from Arthurian legend - but their mission is threatened by old enemies as they uncover a terrible secret about the history of the world. Sci-fi adventure sequel, starring Mark Wahlberg, Anthony Hopkins, Gemma Chan, Stanley Tucci and John Turturro.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: In 1987, lonely Californian teenager Charlie Watson is traumatised by the death of her father and resentful of her mother Sally's relationship with new boyfriend Ronald. For her 18th-birthday she's given a yellow Volkswagen Beetle, which turns out to be the battle-scarred Autobot Bumblebee. Transformers prequel, starring Hailee Steinfeld, John Cena and Jorge Lendeborg Jr.

programme.title: Clash of the Titans
programme.desc: The son of the Greek god Zeus is raised by humans and grows up to reject his immortal heritage in anger at the gods' cruel treatment of humans. He sets out on a quest to find a means to kill the evil lord of the underworld in revenge for his father's death, facing all manner of strange creatures. Mythological adventure, with Sam Worthington, Liam Neeson, Ralph Fiennes and Gemma Arterton.

programme.title: Wrath of the Titans
programme.desc: The Greek god Zeus is betrayed by his fellow immortals, who intend to release the monstrous race of titans they banished to the underworld. His Demi-God son Perseus must rescue his father and protect the human race from the terrifying creatures that have been unleashed on the world. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Sam Worthington, Liam Neeson and Ralph Fiennes.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: A mischievous rabbit has the run of a farm and its vegetable patch when the owner unexpectedly dies. When a relative inherits the property, he strives to rid his land of the rabbit and his woodland friends - but his feelings for a nature-loving woman complicate the battle of wits with the animal kingdom. Family comedy based on Beatrix Potter's stories, starring Domhnall Gleeson and Rose Byrne, with the voices of James Corden and Margot Robbie.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit 2: The Runaway
programme.desc: Thomas and Bea are now married and living with Peter and his rabbit family. Bored of life in the garden, Peter goes to the big city, where he meets shady characters and ends up creating chaos for the whole family. Adventure sequel, starring Rose Byrne and Domhnall Gleeson, with the voices of James Corden and Margot Robbie.

programme.title: Wonder Woman
programme.desc: An Amazon princess who grows up in enchanted realm has her first encounter with the outside world during the First World War. American airman Steve Trevor crash lands on her isolated island home. Determined to bring the chaos sweeping the world to an end, she ventures onto the front line in an attempt to bring down an ancient and powerful evil force that is driving the human race towards destruction. Director Patty Jenkins' blockbusting fantasy adventure, starring Gal Gadot, Chris Pine and David Thewlis.

Writer/director James Gunn's fantasy adventure, starring David Corenswet, Rachel Brosnahan and Nicholas Hoult.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Fuelled by his restored faith in humanity and inspired by Superman's selfless act, Bruce Wayne enlists the help of newfound ally Diana Prince to face an even greater enemy. Together, Batman and Wonder Woman work quickly to find and recruit a team of meta-humans to stand against supervillain Steppenwolf, but despite the help of Aquaman, Cyborg and The Flash, it may already be too late to save the planet. Sci-fi adventure, starring Ben Affleck, Gal Gadot and Henry Cavill.
